resolutions.note: The held text of EO 13381 itself states that it does not supersede or affect the remainder of Executive Order 12968 as amended, so EO 12968 stays in force; EO 14177 Sec. 4(c) only permits clearance requests under EO 12968 or any successor order, and none of these orders ends or alters any clause of EO 14177.

The held text of EO 13467 itself states that it does not supersede or affect the remainder of Executive Order 12968 as amended, so EO 12968 stays in force; EO 14177 Sec. 4(c) only permits clearance requests under EO 12968 or any successor order, and none of these orders ends or alters any clause of EO 14177.

The quoted text of EO 13764 states that nothing in it supersedes or affects the remainder of Executive Order 12968 as amended; it amends parts of EO 12968 only and ends no clause of EO 14177, whose Sec. 4(c) refers to EO 12968 as amended or any successor order.
